title: PolyBridge | Foresight grounded in real-money signal
excerpt: PolyBridge turns fragmented prediction-market signal into structured intelligence — traceable forecasts, causal structure, and live monitoring for high-stakes decisions.
content_html:
Calibrated foresight, grounded in capital

A continuously updated causal model of world state. Ask any question and get a streamed probability with the drivers and markets behind it.

Book a demoExplore API

Ask any question about the future

Get back an answer you can act on, with the markets and drivers behind it.

Backed by

20VCHarry Stebbings, Kieran Hill

KDXAshby Monk, Elliott Donnelley

Six years of cascades

World events are connected

Adjust an input. See the downstream effects

The interface

Forecast

A probability you can act on

Every answer is a precise number with a credible interval. The interval widens when market evidence is thin, or stale, and narrows when it is strong.

Source markets

$151.8m in real capital backing this answer

Each probability traces to the markets that informed it, weighted by liquidity, where real capital is at risk.

Drivers

31% Credit Stress. 19% Geopolitical Escalation

Each driver is a node in the causal model. Condition on it, intervene, or test a counterfactual.
